<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="best-aion-2-settings-at-a-glance">Best AION 2 Settings at a Glance</h2>



<p>If you only want the most important recommendations, start with these settings. They are based on the global Launch Scale Test and are meant as a practical baseline rather than a one-size-fits-all preset.



<figure class="wp-block-table"><table class="has-fixed-layout"><thead><tr><th>Setting</th><th>Recommended Starting Point</th><th>Why</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Control Mode</td><td>AION 2 Mode, then test both</td><td>direct action-style camera control; switch with Minus</td></tr><tr><td>Life Potion Auto Use</td><td>70% by default; lower if you want to conserve potions</td><td>balances safety and resource use</td></tr><tr><td>Buff Auto Use</td><td>In Combat or Motion</td><td>keeps buffs active automatically</td></tr><tr><td>Upscaler</td><td>DLSS or FSR, Quality as a starting point</td><td>one of the easiest ways to gain FPS</td></tr><tr><td>Mass Combat Quality</td><td>Lower first when performance drops</td><td>reduces the load from many visible characters</td></tr><tr><td>Player Particle Effect Display</td><td>You and your party</td><td>cuts visual clutter and helps performance</td></tr><tr><td>Same Appearance for Other Players</td><td>Enable if crowded areas run poorly</td><td>reduces the cost of rendering many unique characters</td></tr><tr><td>NVIDIA Reflex</td><td>Boost in the test client</td><td>helps reduce input latency</td></tr><tr><td>Camera Shake</td><td>Off if it hurts visibility or comfort</td><td>makes combat easier to read</td></tr><tr><td>Display Boss Orientation</td><td>Try enabled for dungeons</td><td>helps you read boss positioning</td></tr></tbody></table></figure>

<p>These are the settings I would check first if you want to improve FPS in AION 2, especially in crowded cities, dungeons, and large-scale battles:



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Upscaler:</strong> DLSS or FSR, along with Resolution Scale. During the test, I used Quality</li>



<li><strong>Frame Generator:</strong> can only be enabled when an upscaler is active. With DLSS, you need an NVIDIA RTX 40-series GPU or newer. On Windows 11, it works immediately; on Windows 10, you need to enable the feature manually and restart your PC</li>



<li><strong>Mass Combat Quality:</strong> controls how many characters are displayed at the same time. In crowded cities and large battles, this is the first setting I would lower</li>



<li><strong>Player Particle Effect Display:</strong> was set to you and your party members. Effects from other players are hidden, which helps performance in large groups</li>



<li><strong>Same Appearance for Other Players:</strong> displays other characters with a standardized appearance. You lose some visual variety, but it should improve performance in crowded areas</li>



<li><strong>NVIDIA Reflex:</strong> was set to Boost during the test and helps reduce input latency</li>
</ul>



<p>The Steam page recommends the Very Low preset for Full HD on the minimum hardware and the Low preset on the recommended hardware. If your PC is close to the minimum requirements, start low and raise the settings one by one.

<p>One particularly useful feature: There are six preset slots, and your layouts can be exported and imported. For example, you can create one layout for questing and another for group content.



<p>HUD Edit is also where you’ll find UI Scale and Chat Font Size, both set to Medium by default. If the chat text is too small, increase it by one step here.

<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="aion-2-combat-visibility-settings">Combat Visibility: Boss Orientation, Skill Range, and Notifications</h2>



<p>Under Info Display > Combat, you can display the range of your skills and enemies’ aggro range, both with adjustable transparency. <strong>Display Boss Orientation</strong> is disabled by default and offers several levels. Try it during your first few dungeons.                <div class="mobile-view mb-10">

        </div>
    



<p>Under Notification, the game warns you when you’re hit or when your HP is low, with the default low-HP threshold set to 20 percent.



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="aion-2-language-accessibility-settings">AION 2 Language, Voice, and Accessibility Settings</h2>



<p>During the test, the interface was available in German, Korean, English, Japanese, and French. There is no German voice-over; you can choose between English, Korean, and Japanese. Both settings are found under Miscellaneous > Language. Steam lists eight supported languages for release, adding Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian.



<p>Under Accessibility, you’ll find color-blindness correction with adjustable intensity, Brightness Reduction for light-sensitive players, and scrolling-text speed. There are also subtitles for cutscenes, while the Communication section lets you adjust the font size and color of each chat channel.                <div class="mobile-view mb-10">

<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="aion-2-keybindings-keyboard-shortcuts">AION 2 Keybindings: All Keyboard Shortcuts</h2>



<p>These are the most important default AION 2 keybindings from the global test client. Almost every action can be rebound under Key Settings, so treat this as a reference rather than a layout you have to keep.



<figure class="wp-block-table"><table class="has-fixed-layout"><thead><tr><th>Action</th><th>Key</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Move</td><td>W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys</td></tr><tr><td>Sprint and Dodge</td><td>Shift</td></tr><tr><td>Jump and Glide</td><td>Space</td></tr><tr><td>Fly</td><td>V</td></tr><tr><td>Ascend and Descend While Flying</td><td>Ctrl+R and Ctrl+F</td></tr><tr><td>Mount</td><td>C</td></tr><tr><td>Switch Target</td><td>Tab</td></tr><tr><td>Display Cursor</td><td>Alt</td></tr><tr><td>Switch Control Mode</td><td>Minus</td></tr><tr><td>Auto Potion Use</td><td>X</td></tr><tr><td>Auto-Navigate to Quest</td><td>Alt+1 to Alt+9</td></tr><tr><td>Combat Analysis</td><td>Ctrl+X</td></tr><tr><td>Target Party Members 1 to 4</td><td>Ctrl+F2 to Ctrl+F5</td></tr><tr><td>Equipment Sets 1, 2, and 3</td><td>Insert, Home, and Page Up</td></tr><tr><td>Consumables</td><td>F1 to F8</td></tr><tr><td>Hide UI</td><td>F12</td></tr></tbody></table></figure>



<figure class="wp-block-table"><table class="has-fixed-layout"><thead><tr><th>Menu</th><th>Key</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Map</td><td>M</td></tr><tr><td>Cube (Inventory)</td><td>I</td></tr><tr><td>Skills</td><td>K</td></tr><tr><td>Journal</td><td>J</td></tr><tr><td>Stat Info</td><td>P</td></tr><tr><td>Daevanion</td><td>U</td></tr><tr><td>Integrated Enhancement</td><td>N</td></tr><tr><td>Legion</td><td>L</td></tr><tr><td>Achievements</td><td>Z</td></tr><tr><td>Shop</td><td>H</td></tr><tr><td>Membership</td><td>G</td></tr><tr><td>Pet</td><td>Alt+X</td></tr><tr><td>Wings</td><td>Alt+C</td></tr><tr><td>Titles</td><td>Alt+T</td></tr><tr><td>Wardrobe</td><td>Alt+O</td></tr><tr><td>Arcana</td><td>Alt+V</td></tr><tr><td>Essence Extraction</td><td>Alt+F</td></tr><tr><td>Crafting</td><td>Alt+G</td></tr><tr><td>Conversion</td><td>Alt+H</td></tr><tr><td>Supply Requests</td><td>Alt+J</td></tr></tbody></table></figure>



<p>Expedition, Daily Dungeon, Nightmare, Transcendence, Shugo Festival, Abyss, Arena, and the World Market are among the menus without a default hotkey. If you open these windows frequently, assign them a key yourself under Key Settings > Menu.



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="aion-2-mouse-sensitivity-fps-limit">Mouse Sensitivity and FPS Limit: What Was Missing in the Test</h2>



<p>In the Launch Scale Test, there were two settings I couldn’t find: a dedicated mouse-sensitivity slider and a traditional frame-rate limiter. The mouse felt very sensitive to me during the test. The closest options I found were the horizontal and vertical camera movement speed sliders under Graphics > Camera / Direction. I didn’t have enough time to determine whether they fully solve the problem. If the global client adds dedicated mouse sensitivity or FPS-cap options at release, I’ll update this section.                <div class="mobile-view mb-10">

<p>My advice is simple: Spend ten minutes in the Settings menu before your first serious play session. Getting your targeting, graphics, camera, HUD, and keybinds right early makes AION 2 noticeably more comfortable to play. Have a great trip to Atreia!

					const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
					const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
						entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
							if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
								let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
								if( lazyloadBackground ) {
									lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
								}
								lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
							}
						});
					}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
					lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
						lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
					} );
				};
				const events = [
					'DOMContentLoaded',
					'elementor/lazyload/observe',
				];
				events.forEach( ( event ) => {
					document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
				} );
